item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Curry-marinated and roasted chicken with rice and a lovely Danish coconut curry sauce with carrot, onion and apple, topped with parsley. Served with accompaniments.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Moroccan turkey tagine with plenty of vegetables, served with couscous tossed with herbs and topped with dried fruit. With lemon yoghurt, harissa chilli, coriander and a cucumber-tomato salad. Gluten free with rice. (1+6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Moroccan cauliflower tagine with plenty of vegetables, served with couscous tossed with herbs and topped with dried fruit. With lemon yoghurt, harissa sauce, coriander and a cucumber-tomato salad. Gluten free with rice. (1+6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Piri piri chicken served with rice and lime-marinated pointed cabbage. (13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Piri piri-marinated tofu served with rice and lime-marinated pointed cabbage. (7+13+15) Kays — 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Smoked cured pork loin glazed with brown sugar, mustard and dill. Served with a white potato salad. (2+6+11+13) GREEN DISH: Dish Butternut squash glazed with brown sugar, mustard and dill. Served with a white potato salad. (2+6+11+13) Kays — 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Indonesian-inspired spiced peanut stew with pork, coconut and vegetables. Served with fluffy rice and topped with spring onion. With coriander, fresh lime, crushed roasted peanuts and chilli sauce. The dish is gluten free. (4+6+7+8+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Indonesian-inspired spiced peanut stew with tofu, coconut and vegetables. Served with fluffy rice and topped with spring onion. With coriander, fresh lime, crushed roasted peanuts and chilli sauce. The dish is gluten free. (4+6+7+8+13+15) Kays — 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.
